decisions.OWN-DEC-015 quality and precision: initial native implementation: float64 internal processing, current 8x proxy, current reference kernel definitions/timing, current machine-rate schedules, current quantizer and converter-clamp semantics, exactly as found at the Sprint 5 checkpoint (research_config_sp_track_a_v1.json / research_config_mpc_track_a_v1.json); no automatic reduction to 4x proxy, shorter kernels, float32, Path A/C, or a different SP reconstruction; optimize computation first (tables, ring buffers, no allocation, cache layout, no redundant coefficients, SIMD only where the numeric contract passes); no fast-math or uncontrolled reassociation; compiler options and FMA/contraction policy recorded; SP sample-and-hold imaging never replaced by an ideal band-limited output

OWN-DEC-016 numerical acceptance (G-08 s.A exact discrete semantics: exact agreement for quantizer rules on identical quantizer inputs, code endpoints, tie handling (implemented ⌊r+½⌋ ties toward +∞ retained), floor/truncation, clamp decisions, code re-expansion, enum/state mappings, rational scheduler event sequences; ROUND_NEAREST never described as universally unbiased (measured bias characterization preserved: SP12 none measured; R13 ROUND_NEAREST mean bias −0.125 LSB16, TRUNCATION +0.375 LSB16 per VAL-012)
OWN-DEC-016 numerical acceptance (G-08 s.B same-build determinism: identical input/configuration/reset/sample-timestamped automation → repeated native renders bit-identical and host-block partitions bit-identical; binary hashes across compilers/CPUs NOT required

OWN-DEC-017 performance budget.load: processing elapsed time / represented audio duration

decisions.OWN-DEC-018 latency: current reference latency is the initial native target (310 @ 48 kHz, 449 @ 96 kHz, verified from code and an independent timing test); initial production ceiling 10 ms algorithmic latency at each rate; fixed per prepared configuration/rate; equal across diagnostic chain modes; available to the future wrapper; independent of callback partitioning; no extra host block of latency for batching; frequency-dependent phase/group delay documented separately from the integer delay; no zero-latency claim
decisions.OWN-DEC-019 buffer and input safety: preallocate for chunks up to 8192 host samples; zero-length, one-sample, irregular, all sizes through 8192, larger buffers via bounded internal chunking; no allocation in process(); event positions/state preserved across internal chunks; normal domain normalized full scale; supported over-range test domain at least −16…+16; no host-boundary clamp of finite input (converter clamps remain the modeled overload); NaN/Inf input samples replaced by zero + diagnostic counter, no engine reset for one bad sample; invalid parameter values rejected/sanitized per explicit documented state policy, never silently promoted; unexpected internal non-finite output → documented fail-safe + fault indication, no NaN to the host, no concealed recurring faults; no hidden limiter/normalization/saturation/noise; no audio-thread allocation, locks, I/O, logging, dependency loading or unbounded work
decisions.OWN-DEC-020 parameters and state v1: schema version 1; ProductParameters / MachineParameters (assets) / ResearchConfiguration separated; frozen SOFTWARE controls: sp_input_level_db −60…+12 default 0 (continuous), sp_input_gain {0,+20,+40} default 0, interstage_level_db −60…+24 default 0 (one explicit R10 gain), mpc_input_gain existing enum/mapping default least-gain (LO; sensitivity labels not full-scale calibration), output_trim_db −60…+12 default 0 (final output gain only), plugin_bypass default false (separate from diagnostic machine bypass; host integration Sprint 7); ranges are OWNER-SET SOFTWARE CONTROL RANGES, not pot ranges or calibration; first product state: SP route NONE_CH7_8, MPC route MAIN_LR, CASCADE mode, R13 ROUND_NEAREST, other rules/modes research-only, physical calibration UNSET (no fake voltage knob); MPC record trim retained internally at its neutral value; interstage vs record trim ownership audited; no drive/wet-dry/reverse/unpopulated routes/calibration hypotheses in presets; state stores schema version, product values, asset identity/version; presets cannot rewrite calibration or research coefficients; unsupported future schema versions rejected explicitly; no invented migrations
decisions.OWN-DEC-021 smoothing: continuous dB controls: 10 ms linear-in-dB ramps converted to linear gain at their defined stage; ramps advance by sample time, not host-buffer duration; identical event times → identical trajectories across partitions; no ramp restart per callback; new target continues from the current smoothed value; reset snaps to the configured initial value; constant parameters preserve the static reference behaviour; clock/event mapping recorded at each rate-domain boundary; separate automation fixtures; old static artifacts not rewritten; discrete switches remain discrete with defined event timing; structural changes never rebuild/allocate in process(); bypass transitions/UI in Sprint 7
decisions.OWN-DEC-022 known meter gap: machine-level input-peak meters reading zero inside the cascade are not carried into the product as a valid silence reading: the native core meters the documented stage boundaries (host input peak, per-machine core-input proxy peak, converter clamp counts) or exposes an explicit unavailable status; reference instrumentation corrections leave audio unchanged with regression evidence
decisions.OWN-DEC-023 governance: this authorization sets G-08 SOFTWARE criteria and the C++ core stack; it does not mark G-08 acceptance PASS before tests run; pending human listening does not block implementing/optimizing the owner-selected Path B; human listening NOT EXECUTED; G-04, G-07H and hardware-fit remain BLOCKED/DEFERRED; original contracts and research unchanged; an owner-set value supersedes an old UNSET placeholder; stop on substantive contradiction
